title: Flight plan timeline, elapsed time 6:00–7:30: terminal rendezvous phase with booster
description: Vertical elapsed-time axis from 6:00 to 7:30 with entries "INITIATE TERMINAL REND PHASE", "MEASURE ΔV REQ'D", "CLOSE WITH BOOSTER PHOTOGRAPHS DURING APPROACH", "INCREASE SEPARATION WITH BOOSTER PRIOR TO DARKNESS" and "GO/NO GO FOR AREA 18-1". Boxed tracking-station codes (HAW, TEX, GYM, CNV, ANT, ASC, PRE, TAN, CSQ) and a hatched "NIGHT" bar run down the right side.
